"""Three exact subsection 2 Native cases; --check never imports CARLA."""

import argparse
from contextlib import ExitStack
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

from officer_camera import CAMERAS, CAMERA_SIZES
from officer_camera_media import CameraMedia
from officer_capture_sequence import run as capture_sequence, write_receipt
from officer_construction import spawn_officer_performer
from officer_direction import PREFIX, SUFFIXES, native_bone_adapter, behavior_suffix
from officer_site import SITE, validate_site
from officer_source_intake import load_and_validate
from officer_traffic_sampler import native_sampler


ASSIGNMENT = PREFIX[:-2]
CASES = {PREFIX + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES}
SWEEP_CASES = {f"{ASSIGNMENT}__c157964_sub2_judgment_{judgment}-{rank:04d}"
               for judgment in (3, 5, 6) for rank in range(3)}


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def validate_config(config):
    site = validate_site()
    if (config.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or
            config.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-257-2" or
            config.get("cell_id") != "C157964" or
            config.get("actor") != "motor_vehicle_driver" or
            config.get("selected_case_id") not in CASES | SWEEP_CASES or
            config.get("case", {}).get("case_id") != config.get("selected_case_id") or
            set(config.get("supported_case_ids", ())) != CASES):
        raise ValueError("Exact subsection 2 officer case identity required")
    if (config.get("rate_hz"), config.get("duration_s")) != (20, 30):
        raise ValueError("Exact officer capture requires 20 Hz and 30 seconds")
    controls = config.get("sweep_controls", {})
    if not isinstance(controls, dict) or set(controls) - {"ego_target_speed_mps", "other_release_frame"}:
        raise ValueError("Unknown physical sweep control")
    target_speed = controls.get("ego_target_speed_mps", 5.0)
    if (type(target_speed) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(target_speed)
            or not 0.0 <= target_speed <= 8.0):
        raise ValueError("Physical ego speed setpoint must be finite in the tested 0-8 m/s range")
    release = controls.get("other_release_frame", 360)
    if (type(release) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(release)
            or int(release) != release):
        raise ValueError("Physical other release frame must be an integer frame")
    if not 0 <= release < 600:
        raise ValueError("Physical other release frame must be within the 600-frame capture")
    if (config.get("site", {}).get("xodr_sha256") != site["site_sha256"] or
            config["site"].get("native_map_id") != "OpenDriveMap" or
            config["site"].get("ego_lane") != [site["ego_road_id"], site["ego_lane_id"]] or
            config["site"].get("other_lane") not in site["through_approaches"]):
        raise ValueError("Authored signed junction or both approach lanes differ")
    cameras = config.get("cameras")
    if (not isinstance(cameras, list) or
            [item.get("name") for item in cameras] != list(CAMERAS) or
            any((item.get("width"), item.get("height")) != CAMERA_SIZES[item["name"]]
                or item.get("fov_deg") != 90 for item in cameras)):
        raise ValueError("Four original cameras differ from the capture profile")
    if set(config.get("camera_mounts", {})) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("Four original camera mounts required")
    for name, mount in config["camera_mounts"].items():
        if (not isinstance(mount, dict) or set(mount) != {"pose", "attach_to"} or
                mount["attach_to"] not in (None, "ego", "other", "officer")):
            raise ValueError("Invalid original camera mount: " + name)
    if (set(config.get("actor_blueprints", {})) != {"ego", "other", "officer"} or
            not all(config["actor_blueprints"].values())):
        raise ValueError("Three explicit Native actor blueprints required")
    for role in ("ego", "other", "officer"):
        pose = config.get("actor_transforms", {}).get(role)
        if (not isinstance(pose, dict) or set(pose) != {"location", "rotation"} or
                set(pose["location"]) != {"x", "y", "z"} or
                set(pose["rotation"]) != {"yaw", "pitch", "roll"}):
            raise ValueError("Explicit Native actor transform required: " + role)
    if (not isinstance(config.get("required_atoms"), list) or
            not all(isinstance(config.get("officer_pose", {}).get(key), dict)
                    and config["officer_pose"][key] for key in ("stop", "go")) or
            not isinstance(config.get("recording_description"), dict)):
        raise ValueError("Officer pose or recording contract missing")
    return config


def _transform(carla, pose):
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(**pose["location"]),
                           carla.Rotation(**pose["rotation"]))


def _copy_source_packet(source_root, output):
    source_root = Path(source_root).resolve()
    packet_path = source_root / "source-packet.json"
    intake = load_and_validate(source_root, packet_path)
    if _sha(source_root / intake["source_paths"]["road"]) != _sha(SITE):
        raise ValueError("Reviewed source packet differs from authored officer site")
    retained = output / "source_review"
    retained.mkdir()
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
    for binding in packet["sources"].values():
        path = Path(binding["path"])
        target = retained / path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source_root / path, target)
    shutil.copy2(packet_path, retained / "source-packet.json")
    load_and_validate(retained, retained / "source-packet.json")
    return retained, intake


def _hazard_plan(path, intake, frames):
    plan = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    rows = plan.get("frames")
    if (plan.get("format") != "worker-officer-approach-construction-plan" or
            plan.get("site_id") != intake["site_id"] or
            not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) != frames or
            any(not isinstance(row, dict) or row.get("frame_index") != i or
                type(row.get("approaching_hazard")) is not bool
                for i, row in enumerate(rows))):
        raise ValueError("Complete source-bound other approach plan required")
    return rows


def other_control(frame_index, frame_count, drive, release_frame=None):
    """Stage the other approach until ego's go phase; physical overlap is audited later."""
    if (type(frame_index) is not int or type(frame_count) is not int or
            frame_count < 3 or not 0 <= frame_index < frame_count or
            not isinstance(drive, dict) or
            set(drive) != {"throttle", "brake", "steer"}):
        raise ValueError("Complete other-vehicle construction command required")
    if release_frame is None:
        release_frame = frame_count * 3 // 5
    if (type(release_frame) not in (int, float) or
            not math.isfinite(release_frame) or
            int(release_frame) != release_frame or
            not 0 <= release_frame < frame_count):
        raise ValueError("Other-vehicle release frame outside capture")
    if frame_index < release_frame:
        return {"throttle": 0.0, "brake": 1.0, "steer": 0.0}
    return dict(drive)


def capture(config, output_dir, host, port):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore

    output = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or not (output / "construction.json").is_file():
        raise ValueError("Materialize exact officer construction before Native capture")
    source_root = os.environ.get("OFFICER_SOURCE_ROOT")
    if not source_root:
        raise ValueError("OFFICER_SOURCE_ROOT with reviewed source packet required")
    retained, intake = _copy_source_packet(source_root, output)
    frames = config["rate_hz"] * config["duration_s"]
    plan = _hazard_plan(retained / intake["source_paths"]["other_route"], intake, frames)
    client = carla.Client(host, int(port))
    client.set_timeout(30)
    saved = snapshot(client)
    error = None
    summary = None
    try:
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(SITE.read_text())
        if world.get_map().name != config["site"]["native_map_id"]:
            raise ValueError("Native officer map identity differs")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / config["rate_hz"]
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        library = world.get_blueprint_library()
        blueprints = {}
        for role, blueprint_id in config["actor_blueprints"].items():
            blueprint = library.find(blueprint_id)
            blueprint.set_attribute("role_name", "c157964_sub2_" + role)
            blueprints[role] = blueprint
        camera_blueprints = {}
        for item in config["cameras"]:
            blueprint = library.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            for key, value in (("image_size_x", item["width"]),
                               ("image_size_y", item["height"]), ("fov", item["fov_deg"])):
                blueprint.set_attribute(key, str(value))
            camera_blueprints[item["name"]] = blueprint
        transforms = {role: _transform(carla, pose)
                      for role, pose in config["actor_transforms"].items()}
        for role in ("ego", "other"):
            waypoint = world.get_map().get_waypoint(transforms[role].location)
            if waypoint is None or [waypoint.road_id, waypoint.lane_id] != config["site"][role + "_lane"]:
                raise ValueError("Native vehicle pose misses selected approach lane: " + role)
        mounts = {name: {"transform": _transform(carla, value["pose"]),
                         "attach_to": value["attach_to"]}
                  for name, value in config["camera_mounts"].items()}
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            actors = {}
            for role in ("ego", "other"):
                actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprints[role], transforms[role])
                if actor is None:
                    raise ValueError("Native vehicle spawn failed: " + role)
                stack.callback(actor.destroy)
                actors[role] = actor
            officer = stack.enter_context(spawn_officer_performer(
                world, blueprints["officer"], transforms["officer"],
                carla.Location(**config["junction_center_xyz_m"])))
            actors["officer"] = officer["actor"]
            adapter = native_bone_adapter(carla, config["officer_pose"]["stop"],
                                          config["officer_pose"]["go"])
            traffic = native_sampler(actors["other"], intake, lambda i: {
                "site_id": intake["site_id"], "other_actor_id": actors["other"].id,
                "approaching_hazard": plan[i]["approaching_hazard"],
                "source": "source_review/" + intake["source_paths"]["other_route"] +
                          "#frame-" + str(i)})
            with CameraMedia(world, output, camera_blueprints, mounts, actors) as media:
                graph = PipelineCapture(client, actors["ego"], output,
                                        config["selected_case_id"],
                                        required_observations=config["required_atoms"])
                try:
                    result = capture_sequence(
                        carla, world, actors["ego"], actors["officer"], adapter,
                        config["selected_case_id"], frame_count=frames,
                        source_root=retained, source_packet=retained / "source-packet.json",
                        other_actor=actors["other"], traffic_sampler=traffic,
                        camera_readback=media.readback,
                        target_speed_mps=config.get("sweep_controls", {}).get("ego_target_speed_mps", 5.0),
                        before_tick=lambda i: actors["other"].apply_control(
                            carla.VehicleControl(**other_control(
                                i, frames, config["drive"]["other"],
                                config.get("sweep_controls", {}).get("other_release_frame")))),
                        after_tick=lambda frame, time_s: graph.capture(frame, time_s))
                except BaseException:
                    graph.close(confirmed=False)
                    raise
                graph.close(confirmed=True)
                write_receipt(result, output / "capture-receipt.json")
                with FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map:
                    for row in result["rows"]:
                        frame_map.append(row["carla_frame"],
                                         row["native_actor_source"]["time_s"],
                                         camera_frames={name: row["carla_frame"] for name in CAMERAS})
            summary = {"frames": len(result["rows"]),
                       "encoder_exit_codes": media.encoder.exit_codes}
    except BaseException as exc:
        error = exc
    try:
        restored = restore(client, saved)
    except BaseException as exc:
        (output / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "capture_sealed": False, "errors": [str(x) for x in (error, exc) if x]}) + "\n")
        raise
    if error is not None:
        (output / "native-run-status.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "capture_sealed": False, "errors": [str(error)]}) + "\n")
        raise error
    seal_capture(output, frames=summary["frames"], restoration=restored, errors=[],
                 encoder_exit_codes=summary["encoder_exit_codes"],
                 context={"selected_case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
                          "reviewed_officer_direction_and_control": False})


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = validate_config(json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("config.json").read_text()))
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
                          "cpu_config_checked": True, "simulation_started": False}))
        return
    if not args.output_dir:
        raise ValueError("Native officer capture requires --output-dir")
    capture(config, args.output_dir, args.host, args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Saved-only subsection 2 finalization of original Native and camera sources."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from officer_camera import CAMERAS
from officer_saved_review import process
from officer_site import validate_site


ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C157964__NRS-484B-257-2__motor_vehicle_driver"
CHANNELS = ("officer_control_observed", "officer_direction_observed",
            "ego_body_in_intersection", "other_body_in_intersection",
            "other_approaching_observed", "ego_speed_mps", "other_speed_mps")


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _rows(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def measure_signed_entrance(attempt, observed):
    packet = json.loads((attempt / "source_review/source-packet.json").read_text())
    review = packet["review"]
    return {"site_id": packet["site_id"], "entrances": review["entrances"],
            "non_through_highway": True}


def measure_officer_control(attempt, observed):
    entry = observed["first_ego_entry"] or observed["first_hold_observation"]
    return entry["traffic_control_observed"]


def measure_officer_direction(attempt, observed):
    entry = observed["first_ego_entry"] or observed["first_hold_observation"]
    return entry["officer_direction_observed"]


def measure_other_traffic(attempt, observed):
    entry = observed["first_ego_entry"] or observed["first_hold_observation"]
    sample = next(row for row in observed["samples"] if row["frame"] == entry["frame"])
    return {"frame": entry["frame"],
            "body_in_intersection": sample["other_body_in_intersection"],
            "approaching_observed": sample["other_approaching_observed"],
            "immediate_hazard_judgment": "unresolved"}


def measure_ego_response(attempt, observed):
    entry = observed["first_ego_entry"] or observed["first_hold_observation"]
    sample = next(row for row in observed["samples"] if row["frame"] == entry["frame"])
    return {"frame": entry["frame"], "body_in_intersection": sample["ego_body_in_intersection"],
            "speed_mps": sample["ego_speed_mps"], "caution_judgment": "unresolved"}


def finalize(attempt, output, *, assessor=None, writer=None):
    attempt, output = Path(attempt).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() or (attempt / "result.json").exists() or (attempt / "channels").exists():
        raise ValueError("Retain prior saved finalization; choose a new attempt")
    required = ("runner.py", "config.json", "construction.json", "officer-site.xodr",
                "capture-receipt.json", "officer_review.json", "source_review/source-packet.json",
                "trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "capture/evidence.jsonl",
                *(name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS))
    for name in required:
        path = attempt / name
        if not path.is_file() or not path.stat().st_size:
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + name)
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    if (config.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT or
            config.get("law_id") != "NRS-484B-257-2" or
            config.get("cell_id") != "C157964" or
            config.get("actor") != "motor_vehicle_driver" or
            config.get("case", {}).get("case_id") != config.get("selected_case_id")):
        raise ValueError("Exact saved subsection 2 case identity required")
    site = validate_site(attempt / "officer-site.xodr")
    if config["site"]["xodr_sha256"] != site["site_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Saved officer site source differs")
    capture = json.loads((attempt / "capture-receipt.json").read_text())
    if capture.get("case_id") != config["selected_case_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Saved capture case differs")
    observed = process(
        attempt / "capture-receipt.json", attempt / "officer_review.json",
        attempt / "source_review", attempt / "source_review/source-packet.json",
        attempt, native_map_id=config["site"]["native_map_id"],
        intersection_id=config["officer_context"]["intersection_id"],
    )
    frame_map = _rows(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl")
    trace = _rows(attempt / "trace.jsonl")
    events = _rows(attempt / "capture/evidence.jsonl")
    samples = observed["samples"]
    if len(frame_map) != len(trace) or len(trace) != len(events) or len(events) != len(samples):
        raise ValueError("Original graph, camera and officer source counts differ")
    for frame, motion, event, sample in zip(frame_map, trace, events, samples):
        if (motion.get("frame") != frame.get("carla_frame") or
                motion.get("time_s") != frame.get("time_s") or
                event.get("original_frame") != frame.get("carla_frame") or
                sample["frame"] != frame.get("carla_frame") or
                sample["time_s"] != frame.get("time_s")):
            raise ValueError("Original graph, camera and officer frame join differs")
    channels = attempt / "channels"
    channels.mkdir()
    channel_keys = dict(zip(CHANNELS, (
        "traffic_control_observed", "direction", "ego_body_in_intersection",
        "other_body_in_intersection", "other_approaching_observed",
        "ego_speed_mps", "other_speed_mps")))
    other_speeds = [row["native_actor_source"]["other"]["speed_mps"]
                    for row in capture["rows"]]
    sweep_measurements = config["case"].get("sweep_measurements", [])
    sweep_names = {axis["observable"] for axis in sweep_measurements}
    first_other_entry = next((sample["frame"] for sample in samples
                              if sample["other_body_in_intersection"]), None)
    if "other_first_body_entry_frame" in sweep_names:
        if first_other_entry is None:
            raise ValueError("Other complete body never entered the original intersection source")
        with (channels / "other_first_body_entry_frame.jsonl").open("x") as stream:
            for sample in samples:
                stream.write(json.dumps({"original_frame": sample["frame"],
                                         "time_s": sample["time_s"],
                                         "value": first_other_entry}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    for name, key in channel_keys.items():
        with (channels / (name + ".jsonl")).open("x") as stream:
            for index, sample in enumerate(samples):
                value = other_speeds[index] if name == "other_speed_mps" else sample[key]
                stream.write(json.dumps({"original_frame": sample["frame"],
                                         "time_s": sample["time_s"], "value": value},
                                        allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    source_names = required + ("officer_context.json", "officer_history.jsonl")
    sources = {name: _sha(attempt / name) for name in source_names}
    (channels / "officer_context.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "officer_context": {
            "first_ego_entry": observed["first_ego_entry"],
            "first_hold_observation": observed["first_hold_observation"],
            "police_authority_judgment": observed["police_authority_judgment"],
            "legal_control_exception_judgment": "unresolved",
        },
        "case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
        "first_ego_entry": observed["first_ego_entry"],
        "first_hold_observation": observed["first_hold_observation"],
        "legal_control_exception_judgment": "unresolved",
        "police_authority_judgment": observed["police_authority_judgment"],
        "source_sha256": sources,
    }, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    checks = []
    for check in observed["target_checks"]:
        checks.append(dict(check,
                           method="Independent original-camera review joined to Native complete-body frame",
                           tolerance="exact categorical observation",
                           cause_evidence=["officer_review.json", "capture-receipt.json",
                                           "video_frames.jsonl"]))
    result = {
        "case_id": config["selected_case_id"],
        "measured_values": {"first_ego_entry": observed["first_ego_entry"],
                            "first_hold_observation": observed["first_hold_observation"],
                            "other_inside_at_ego_entry": observed["other_inside_at_ego_entry"],
                            "other_approaching_observed_at_ego_entry": observed["other_approaching_observed_at_ego_entry"],
                            "legal_control_exception_judgment": "unresolved"},
        "target_checks": checks,
        "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
        "maneuver_completed": False,
        "termination_reason": "Saved original-source assessment pending independent physical review",
        "physical_failure_flags": [],
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": [name + ".mkv" for name in CAMERAS],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": config["recording_description"],
        "recording_evidence": [
            {"name": name, "unit": next(channel["unit"] for channel in
                                         config["recording_description"]["channels"] if channel["name"] == name),
             "reference": "channels/" + name + ".jsonl"}
            for name in CHANNELS + (("other_first_body_entry_frame",)
                                    if "other_first_body_entry_frame" in sweep_names else ())
        ] + [{"name": "officer_context", "unit": "structured record",
              "reference": "channels/officer_context.json"}],
        "source_evidence_hashes": sources,
        "realized_observables": {},
    }
    if assessor is None or writer is None:
        from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result, write_result
        assessor = physical_result
        writer = write_result
    result = assessor(attempt, result)
    for axis in sweep_measurements:
        observable = axis["observable"]
        result.setdefault("realized_observables", {})[observable] = dict(
            axis["measurement"], unit=axis["unit"],
            reference="channels/" + observable + ".jsonl",
            value=(max(sample["ego_speed_mps"] for sample in samples)
                   if observable == "ego_speed_mps" else first_other_entry),
            sample_window_s=[samples[0]["time_s"], samples[-1]["time_s"]])
    writer(attempt, result)
    measurement_spec = {
        "signed_entrance": (measure_signed_entrance, ("source_review/source-packet.json",)),
        "officer_control": (measure_officer_control, ("officer_review.json", "capture-receipt.json")),
        "officer_direction": (measure_officer_direction, ("officer_review.json", "video_frames.jsonl")),

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CAMERAS = {"overview": (1920, 1080), "approach": (1280, 720),
           "reference_corner": (1280, 720), "driver_reference": (1280, 720)}
SUFFIXES = ("officer_controls_go", "officer_controls_hold", "officer_present_inactive")
SWEEP_CASES = tuple(f"{HERE.name}__c157964_sub2_judgment_{judgment}-{index:04d}"
                    for judgment in (3, 5, 6) for index in range(3))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing original source: " + path.name)
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def rows(path):
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing original source: " + path.name)
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def audit(attempt, case_id, diagnostic_fixture=False):
    from worker_exchange.media import audit as audit_video
    from worker_exchange.measurement_contract import validate, verify_report

    attempt = Path(attempt).resolve()
    if case_id not in {HERE.name + "__" + suffix for suffix in SUFFIXES} | set(SWEEP_CASES):
        raise ValueError("Wrong exact subsection 2 case")
    suffix = case_id.rsplit("__", 1)[-1]
    config, result = read(attempt / "config.json"), read(attempt / "result.json")
    if (config.get("selected_case_id") != case_id or config.get("rate_hz") != 20
            or config.get("duration_s") != 30 or result.get("case_id") != case_id):
        raise ValueError("Exact case or capture profile changed")
    if not diagnostic_fixture and (result.get("provenance_kind") != "native"
                                   or result.get("diagnostic_fixture")):
        raise ValueError("Native original provenance required")
    mapping = rows(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl")
    history = rows(attempt / "officer_history.jsonl")
    trace = rows(attempt / "trace.jsonl")
    review = read(attempt / "officer_review.json")
    receipt = read(attempt / "capture-receipt.json")
    expected = 3 if diagnostic_fixture else 600
    if not all(len(seq) == expected for seq in (mapping, history, trace, review.get("frames", []), receipt.get("rows", []))):
        raise ValueError("Full original frame, actor, trace and review streams required")
    if receipt.get("case_id") != case_id or receipt.get("frame_count") != expected or review.get("case_id") != case_id:
        raise ValueError("Original capture or reviewer case mismatch")
    for i, (frame, actor, vehicle, review_frame, capture) in enumerate(zip(
            mapping, history, trace, review["frames"], receipt["rows"])):
        native = frame.get("carla_frame")
        time_s = frame.get("time_s")
        if (frame.get("video_frame") != i or type(native) is not int
                or not isinstance(time_s, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(time_s)
                or actor.get("frame") != native or vehicle.get("frame") != native
                or review_frame.get("carla_frame") != native or capture.get("carla_frame") != native):
            raise ValueError("Original frame join changed")
        if i and (native != mapping[i-1]["carla_frame"] + 1
                  or abs(time_s - mapping[i-1]["time_s"] - .05) > .001):
            raise ValueError("Original 20 Hz frame sequence changed")
        if (not actor.get("ego", {}).get("body_vertices_xy_m")
                or not actor.get("other_body_vertices_xy_m")):
            raise ValueError("Original complete-body geometry missing")
        for key in ("officer_direction_observed", "traffic_control_observed",
                    "other_approaching_observed", "officer_actor_id"):
            if actor.get(key) != review_frame.get(key):
                raise ValueError("Original reviewer and actor history disagree: " + key)
        for camera in CAMERAS:
            reference = camera + ".mkv#frame-" + str(i)
            if capture.get("native_actor_source", {}).get("camera_raw_sources", {}).get(camera) != reference:
                raise ValueError("Original capture camera reference changed")
    for camera, dimensions in CAMERAS.items():
        source = attempt / (camera + ".mkv")
        if review.get("camera_sha256", {}).get(camera) != sha(source):
            raise ValueError("Original camera source hash changed: " + camera)
        decoded = audit_video(source, expected, mapping_sha256=sha(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl"))
        if decoded.get("dimensions") != list(dimensions):
            raise ValueError("Original camera dimensions changed: " + camera)
    report = read(attempt / "analysis-report.json")
    for name, digest in report.get("source_report", {}).get("sources", {}).items():
        if name not in ("officer_context.json", "officer_history.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl") or sha(attempt / name) != digest:
            raise ValueError("Saved analysis source binding changed")

    validate(contract, plan["requirement_dispositions"], (HERE / "finalizer.py").read_text(), case_id)
    measured = verify_report(contract, report, attempt)
    if len(measured) != 5:
        raise ValueError("Five selected source-bound measurements required")
    if (report.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") or report.get("legal_conclusion") != "unresolved"
            or result.get("physical_acceptance_claimed")):
        raise ValueError("Software sources claim physical or legal acceptance")
    if not diagnostic_fixture and (result.get("physical_checks", {}).get("setup", {}).get("status") != "met"
                                   or result.get("physical_checks", {}).get("maneuver", {}).get("status") != "met"):
        raise ValueError("Original physical setup and maneuver not confirmed")
    return {"format": "worker-c157964-sub2-independent-source-audit", "case_id": case_id,
            "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic_fixture, "original_frames": expected,
            "frame_map_sha256": sha(attempt / "video_frames.jsonl"),
            "actor_history_sha256": sha(attempt / "officer_history.jsonl"),
            "sealed_result_sha256": sha(attempt / "result.json"),
            "analysis_sha256": sha(attempt / "analysis-report.json"),
            "verified_measurements": sorted(measured), "software_audit_passed": True,
            "physical_acceptance_claimed": False, "legal_conclusion": "unresolved"}

    parser.add_argument("--case", required=True)

"""Synchronous 20 Hz Native capture construction for subsection 2 cases.

The source packet is checked before the first tick. This module retains raw
camera references and Native commands for each frame; later processing must
review original pixels and actor histories independently.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from officer_capture_step import step
from officer_native_sources import record as record_native_sources
from officer_source_intake import load_and_validate
from officer_site import validate_site


def run(carla, world, ego, officer, bone_adapter, case_id, *, frame_count,
        source_root, source_packet, other_actor, traffic_sampler, camera_readback,
        before_tick=None, after_tick=None, target_speed_mps=5.0):
    if type(frame_count) is not int or frame_count < 3:
        raise ValueError("Complete 20 Hz frame count required")
    settings = world.get_settings()
    delta = getattr(settings, "fixed_delta_seconds", None)
    if (getattr(settings, "synchronous_mode", None) is not True or
            type(delta) not in (float, int) or not math.isfinite(delta) or
            abs(delta - 0.05) > 1e-6):
        raise ValueError("Native 20 Hz synchronous settings required")
    packet_path = Path(source_packet)
    intake = load_and_validate(source_root, packet_path)
    validate_site(Path(source_root) / intake["source_paths"]["road"])
    if not callable(traffic_sampler):
        raise ValueError("Original traffic sampler required")
    rows = []
    previous_frame = -1
    previous_time = -math.inf
    for frame_index in range(frame_count):
        traffic = traffic_sampler(frame_index)
        if before_tick is not None:
            before_tick(frame_index)
        row = step(carla, world, ego, officer, bone_adapter, case_id,
                   frame_index, frame_count, traffic, camera_readback, intake,
                   target_speed_mps=target_speed_mps)
        row["native_actor_source"] = record_native_sources(world, ego, other_actor, row)
        native_frame = row["carla_frame"]
        if native_frame <= previous_frame:
            raise ValueError("Native capture frames not strictly increasing")
        native_time = row["native_actor_source"]["time_s"]
        if native_time <= previous_time:
            raise ValueError("Native capture time not strictly increasing")
        previous_frame = native_frame
        previous_time = native_time
        rows.append(row)
        if after_tick is not None:
            after_tick(native_frame, native_time)
    return {"format": "worker-officer-subsection-2-native-capture",
            "case_id": case_id, "site_id": intake["site_id"],
            "source_packet_sha256": hashlib.sha256(packet_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "fixed_delta_seconds": 0.05, "frame_count": frame_count,
            "first_carla_frame": rows[0]["carla_frame"],
            "last_carla_frame": rows[-1]["carla_frame"],
            "rows": rows, "physical_visibility_judgment": "unreviewed",
            "police_authority_judgment": "unreviewed",
            "legal_exception_judgment": "unresolved"}


def write_receipt(capture, destination):
    """Persist a small text receipt only after every capture frame succeeded."""
    if not isinstance(capture, dict) or capture.get("format") != "worker-officer-subsection-2-native-capture":
        raise ValueError("Complete Native capture receipt required")
    if len(capture.get("rows", ())) != capture.get("frame_count"):
        raise ValueError("Incomplete Native capture rows")
    path = Path(destination)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(capture, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}

"""One synchronous Native step for the three exact officer comparison cases.

The programmed arm pose and controller command are construction facts. Raw
camera frame references are kept separately for later original-frame review.
"""

import math

from officer_direction import apply_direction
from officer_ego_controller import apply_native, command


CAMERAS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def _speed(actor):
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    values = (velocity.x, velocity.y, velocity.z)
    if any(type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value) for value in values):
        raise ValueError("Native ego speed readback missing")
    return math.sqrt(sum(value * value for value in values))


def step(carla, world, ego, officer, bone_adapter, case_id, frame_index,
         frame_count, traffic_sample, camera_readback, source_intake,
         target_speed_mps=5.0):
    """Command one tick and bind all four raw camera sources to its frame.

    ``traffic_sample`` is supplied by a source adapter for actor-body
    occupancy and reviewed approaching-hazard judgment. This function refuses
    absent source references. It never derives legal hazard from distance.
    """
    if (not isinstance(source_intake, dict) or
            source_intake.get("format") != "worker-officer-subsection-2-source-intake" or
            not source_intake.get("site_id")):
        raise ValueError("Reviewed officer site intake required")
    if not isinstance(traffic_sample, dict) or not traffic_sample.get("source"):
        raise ValueError("Original other-traffic source required")
    if type(traffic_sample.get("other_inside")) is not bool or type(traffic_sample.get("approaching_hazard")) is not bool:
        raise ValueError("Sourced other-body and approaching-hazard inputs required")
    if (traffic_sample.get("site_id") != source_intake["site_id"] or
            type(traffic_sample.get("other_actor_id")) is not int or
            not isinstance(traffic_sample.get("other_body_vertices_xy_m"), list) or
            len(traffic_sample["other_body_vertices_xy_m"]) < 4 or
            not isinstance(traffic_sample.get("hazard_source"), str) or
            not traffic_sample["hazard_source"]):
        raise ValueError("Native other body and hazard source binding required")
    if not callable(camera_readback):
        raise ValueError("Four-camera readback adapter required")
    pose = apply_direction(officer, bone_adapter, case_id, frame_index, frame_count)
    selected = command(case_id, pose["programmed_direction"],
                       other_inside=traffic_sample["other_inside"],
                       approaching_hazard=traffic_sample["approaching_hazard"],
                       current_speed_mps=_speed(ego), target_speed_mps=target_speed_mps)
    control = apply_native(carla, ego, selected)
    native_frame = world.tick()
    if type(native_frame) is not int:
        raise ValueError("Native world tick frame missing")
    cameras = camera_readback(native_frame)
    if not isinstance(cameras, dict) or set(cameras) != set(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError("Four original camera frames required")
    for name in CAMERAS:
        frame = cameras[name]
        if (not isinstance(frame, dict) or frame.get("carla_frame") != native_frame or
                not isinstance(frame.get("raw_source"), str) or not frame["raw_source"]):
            raise ValueError("Original camera frame mismatch: " + name)
    return {"case_id": case_id, "frame_index": frame_index, "carla_frame": native_frame,
            "reviewed_site_id": source_intake["site_id"],
            "officer_program": pose, "ego_control": control,
            "traffic_source": traffic_sample, "camera_raw_sources": cameras,
            "officer_direction_observed": "unreviewed",
            "actual_police_control_observed": "unreviewed"}

def _sha(path):

def _output_root(path):

    return path


def _camera_path(capture_path, reference, index):
    if not isinstance(reference, str) or not reference.endswith("#frame-" + str(index)):
        raise ValueError("Original camera video frame index differs")
    video = Path(reference.rsplit("#frame-", 1)[0])
    if not video.is_absolute():
        video = capture_path.parent / video
    video = video.resolve()
    if not video.is_relative_to(capture_path.parent.resolve()) or not video.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Original camera video source missing from attempt")
    return video


def _probe_camera(path, expected_frames):
    command = ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-count_frames", "-select_streams", "v:0",
               "-show_entries", "stream=codec_name,nb_read_frames", "-of", "json", str(path)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    streams = json.loads(result.stdout).get("streams", [])
    if (len(streams) != 1 or streams[0].get("codec_name") != "ffv1" or
            streams[0].get("nb_read_frames") != str(expected_frames)):
        raise ValueError("Original camera video decode or frame count differs")


def process(capture_path, review_path, source_root, source_packet, output_root,
            *, native_map_id, intersection_id):
    capture_path, review_path = Path(capture_path), Path(review_path)
    capture = json.loads(capture_path.read_text())
    review = json.loads(review_path.read_text())
    intake = load_and_validate(source_root, source_packet)
    if (capture.get("format") != "worker-officer-subsection-2-native-capture" or
            capture.get("site_id") != intake["site_id"] or
            capture.get("source_packet_sha256") != _sha(source_packet) or
            capture.get("case_id") not in EXPECTED):
        raise ValueError("Native capture and reviewed site source differ")
    rows = capture.get("rows")
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or len(rows) < 3 or len(rows) != capture.get("frame_count"):
        raise ValueError("Incomplete Native capture for saved review")
    if (review.get("format") != "worker-officer-subsection-2-original-frame-review" or
            review.get("case_id") != capture.get("case_id") or
            review.get("site_id") != intake["site_id"] or
            review.get("capture_sha256") != _sha(capture_path) or
            review.get("source_packet_sha256") != _sha(source_packet) or
            not isinstance(review.get("reviewer"), str) or not review["reviewer"]):
        raise ValueError("Independent original-frame review binding missing")
    observed = review.get("frames")
    if not isinstance(observed, list) or len(observed) != len(rows):
        raise ValueError("Incomplete original-frame review")
    if not isinstance(native_map_id, str) or not native_map_id or type(intersection_id) is not int:
        raise ValueError("Native map and intersection identity required")
    camera_hashes = review.get("camera_sha256")
    camera_names = {"overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference"}
    if not isinstance(camera_hashes, dict) or set(camera_hashes) != camera_names:
        raise ValueError("Four original camera hashes required")
    video_paths = {}
    first = rows[0]["native_actor_source"]
    officer_id = first.get("officer_actor_id")
    if type(officer_id) is not int:
        raise ValueError("Original officer actor identity required")
    source_paths = intake["source_paths"]
    site = json.loads(Path(source_packet).read_text())["review"]
    entrances = {item["entrance_id"]: item for item in site["entrances"]}
    context = {"native_map_id": native_map_id, "intersection_id": intersection_id,
               "case_id": capture["case_id"],
               "officer_actor_id": officer_id,
               "authority_source": source_paths["officer_authority"],
               "uniform_video_source": None,
               "direction_video_source": None,
               "junction_source": source_paths["road"],
               "ego_route_source": source_paths["road"],
               "sign_inventory_source": source_paths["sign_inventory"],
               "other_entrance_source": source_paths["sign_inventory"],
               "highway_status_source": source_paths["road"],
               "non_through_highway": True,
               "ego_entrance_device": entrances[intake["ego_entrance_id"]]["device"],
               "other_entrance_device": entrances[intake["other_entrance_id"]]["device"],
               "intersection_polygon_xy_m": intake["intersection_polygon_xy_m"]}
    history, frame_map = [], []
    for index, (row, observation) in enumerate(zip(rows, observed)):
        source = row.get("native_actor_source")
        if not isinstance(source, dict) or source.get("frame") != row.get("carla_frame"):
            raise ValueError("Native source and capture frame differ")
        refs = source.get("camera_raw_sources")
        if not isinstance(refs, dict) or set(refs) != camera_names:
            raise ValueError("Four original camera sources required")
        for name in camera_names:
            video = _camera_path(capture_path, refs[name], index)
            if name in video_paths and video_paths[name] != video:
                raise ValueError("Original camera source changed within capture")
            video_paths[name] = video
        if (not isinstance(observation, dict) or
                observation.get("carla_frame") != source["frame"] or
                observation.get("officer_actor_id") != officer_id or
                observation.get("direction_frame_source") not in refs.values() or
                observation.get("uniform_frame_source") not in refs.values() or
                observation.get("control_frame_source") not in refs.values() or
                observation.get("other_frame_source") not in refs.values() or
                observation.get("officer_direction_observed") not in ("stop", "go", "unclear", "none") or
                type(observation.get("traffic_control_observed")) is not bool or
                type(observation.get("other_approaching_observed")) is not bool):
            raise ValueError("Original-frame officer review differs from Native sources")
        if source.get("officer_actor_id") != officer_id:
            raise ValueError("Officer actor identity changed")
        ego, other = source.get("ego"), source.get("other")
        if not isinstance(ego, dict) or not isinstance(other, dict):
            raise ValueError("Native ego and other body sources required")
        history.append({"frame": source["frame"], "time_s": source["time_s"],
                        "officer_actor_id": officer_id,
                        "officer_direction_observed": observation["officer_direction_observed"],
                        "direction_frame_source": observation["direction_frame_source"],
                        "traffic_control_observed": observation["traffic_control_observed"],
                        "other_frame_source": observation["other_frame_source"],
                        "other_approaching_observed": observation["other_approaching_observed"],
                        "ego": {"speed_mps": ego["speed_mps"],
                                "body_vertices_xy_m": ego["body_vertices_xy_m"]},
                        "other_body_vertices_xy_m": other["body_vertices_xy_m"]})
        frame_map.append({"video_frame": index, "carla_frame": source["frame"],
                          "time_s": source["time_s"]})
    for name, path in video_paths.items():
        if _sha(path) != camera_hashes[name]:
            raise ValueError("Original camera bytes differ: " + name)
        _probe_camera(path, len(rows))
    context["uniform_video_source"] = observed[0]["uniform_frame_source"]
    context["direction_video_source"] = observed[0]["direction_frame_source"]
    output_root = _output_root(output_root)
    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    existing_map = output_root / "video_frames.jsonl"
    if existing_map.exists():
        original_map = [json.loads(line) for line in existing_map.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
        if len(original_map) != len(frame_map) or any(
                any(original.get(key) != expected[key] for key in ("video_frame", "carla_frame", "time_s"))
                for original, expected in zip(original_map, frame_map)):
            raise ValueError("Capture-time original frame map differs from saved review")
    else:
        existing_map.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in frame_map))
    for name, payload in (("officer_context.json", json.dumps(context, sort_keys=True) + "\n"),
                          ("officer_history.jsonl", "".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in history))):
        path = output_root / name
        if path.exists():
            raise ValueError("Saved source already exists: " + name)
        path.write_text(payload)
    result = analyze(output_root)
    result["capture_sha256"] = _sha(capture_path)
    result["review_sha256"] = _sha(review_path)
    result["source_packet_sha256"] = _sha(source_packet)
    expected_control, expected_direction = EXPECTED[capture["case_id"]]
    entry = result["first_ego_entry"] or result.get("first_hold_observation")
    result["case_id"] = capture["case_id"]
    result["target_checks"] = [
        {"target": "officer_control_observed_at_ego_entry",
         "requested": expected_control,
         "measured": entry["traffic_control_observed"],
         "matched": entry["traffic_control_observed"] is expected_control,
         "physical_cause_confirmed": False},
        {"target": "officer_direction_observed_at_ego_entry",
         "requested": expected_direction,
         "measured": entry["officer_direction_observed"],
         "matched": entry["officer_direction_observed"] == expected_direction,
         "physical_cause_confirmed": False}]
    if capture["case_id"] == PREFIX + "officer_controls_hold":
        held = result["first_ego_entry"] is None
        result["target_checks"].append({
            "target": "ego_held_outside_intersection",
            "requested": True, "measured": held, "matched": held,
            "physical_cause_confirmed": False})
    return result

        raise ValueError("Officer-control site contains a signal controller")
    junctions = root.findall("junction")
    if len(junctions) != 1 or junctions[0].get("id") != str(JUNCTION):
        raise ValueError("Officer junction identity differs")
    connections = {(int(c.get("incomingRoad")), int(c.get("connectingRoad")))
                   for c in junctions[0].findall("connection")}
    if connections != {(EGO_ROAD, 157962), (THROUGH_SOUTH, 157965),
                       (THROUGH_NORTH, 157965)}:
        raise ValueError("Officer ego or through routes are disconnected")
    ego = roads[EGO_ROAD]
    ego_lanes = ego.findall("./lanes/laneSection/right/lane")
    if (len(ego_lanes) != 1 or ego_lanes[0].get("id") != "-1" or
            ego_lanes[0].get("type") != "driving" or

    signs = root.findall(".//signals/signal")

            signs[0].find("validity").get("fromLane") != "-1" or
            signs[0].find("validity").get("toLane") != "-1"):

    return {"site_sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),

"""Native other-vehicle body sampling for the signed entrance comparison.

The sampled body can establish geometric occupancy. Whether an approaching
vehicle is an immediate hazard remains an explicit source-reviewed input.
"""

import math
from shapely.geometry import MultiPoint, Polygon


def native_sampler(other_actor, site_intake, hazard_source):
    if (not isinstance(site_intake, dict) or
            site_intake.get("format") != "worker-officer-subsection-2-source-intake" or
            not site_intake.get("site_id")):
        raise ValueError("Reviewed site intake required for body sampling")
    polygon = Polygon(site_intake.get("intersection_polygon_xy_m", []))
    if not polygon.is_valid or polygon.area <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Reviewed intersection polygon required")
    if type(getattr(other_actor, "id", None)) is not int:
        raise ValueError("Native other vehicle identity required")
    if not callable(hazard_source):
        raise ValueError("Approaching-hazard source adapter required")

    def sample(frame_index):
        if type(frame_index) is not int or frame_index < 0:
            raise ValueError("Native sample frame index required")
        box = getattr(other_actor, "bounding_box", None)
        if box is None or not hasattr(box, "get_world_vertices"):
            raise ValueError("Native other vehicle bounding box required")
        vertices = box.get_world_vertices(other_actor.get_transform())
        if not isinstance(vertices, (list, tuple)) or len(vertices) < 4:
            raise ValueError("Complete Native other vehicle body required")
        points = []
        for vertex in vertices:
            x, y = getattr(vertex, "x", None), getattr(vertex, "y", None)
            if (type(x) not in (int, float) or type(y) not in (int, float) or
                    not math.isfinite(x) or not math.isfinite(y)):
                raise ValueError("Finite Native other vehicle body required")
            points.append((float(x), float(y)))
        body = MultiPoint(points).convex_hull
        if body.geom_type != "Polygon" or body.area <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Degenerate Native other vehicle body")
        hazard = hazard_source(frame_index)
        if (not isinstance(hazard, dict) or
                hazard.get("site_id") != site_intake["site_id"] or
                hazard.get("other_actor_id") != other_actor.id or
                type(hazard.get("approaching_hazard")) is not bool or
                not isinstance(hazard.get("source"), str) or not hazard["source"]):
            raise ValueError("Sourced approaching-hazard judgment required")
        return {"source": "Native other-actor bounding-box readback",
                "site_id": site_intake["site_id"], "frame_index": frame_index,
                "other_actor_id": other_actor.id,
                "other_body_vertices_xy_m": [list(point) for point in points],
                "other_inside": body.intersects(polygon),
                "approaching_hazard": hazard["approaching_hazard"],
                "hazard_source": hazard["source"],
                "legal_immediate_hazard_judgment": "unresolved"}

    return sample

                       ego_positions=(-9, -4, -3)):

                        "-frames:v", "3", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-level", "3",
                        "-pix_fmt", "bgr0", str(root / (name + ".mkv"))],
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
    rows, observations = [], []
    for index, x in enumerate(ego_positions):
        frame = 100 + index
        refs = {name: name + ".mkv#frame-" + str(index) for name in camera_names}
        rows.append({"carla_frame": frame, "native_actor_source": {
            "frame": frame, "time_s": frame * 0.05, "officer_actor_id": 12,
            "programmed_direction": "stop", "native_pose_applied": True,
            "camera_raw_sources": refs,
            "ego": {"actor_id": 11, "speed_mps": 1.0, "body_vertices_xy_m": body(x)},
            "other": {"actor_id": 33, "speed_mps": 0.0,
                      "body_vertices_xy_m": body(0)}}})
        observations.append({"carla_frame": frame, "officer_actor_id": 12,
                             "direction_frame_source": refs["approach"],
                             "uniform_frame_source": refs["overview"],
                             "control_frame_source": refs["reference_corner"],

        "case_id": case_id, "source_packet_sha256": sha(packet),
        "frame_count": len(rows), "rows": rows})

        "format": "worker-officer-subsection-2-original-frame-review",
        "site_id": "test-site", "case_id": case_id, "reviewer": "CPU fixture reviewer",
        "capture_sha256": sha(capture), "source_packet_sha256": sha(packet),
        "camera_sha256": {name: sha(root / (name + ".mkv")) for name in camera_names},
        "frames": observations})
    return capture, review

class OfficerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def fixture(self,root,active=True):
        ctx={"native_map_id":"TownX","intersection_id":44,"officer_actor_id":25,
             "authority_source":"reviewed-operator-roster","uniform_video_source":"detail-original",
             "direction_video_source":"front-original","junction_source":"native-polygon",
             "ego_route_source":"native-waypoints","sign_inventory_source":"native-signs",
             "other_entrance_source":"native-road","highway_status_source":"source-review",
             "non_through_highway":True,"ego_entrance_device":"yield",
             "other_entrance_device":"none",
             "intersection_polygon_xy_m":[[10,-5],[20,-5],[20,5],[10,5]]}
        (root/"officer_context.json").write_text(json.dumps(ctx))
        rows=[]
        for i,(x,direction) in enumerate(((0,"stop"),(0,"go"),(12,"go"))):
            rows.append({"frame":100+i,"time_s":1+i*.05,"officer_actor_id":25,
                         "officer_direction_observed":direction,
                         "direction_frame_source":"front-original",
                         "traffic_control_observed":active,
                         "other_frame_source":"overview-original",
                         "other_approaching_observed":False,
                         "ego":{"speed_mps":0 if i<2 else 2,"body_vertices_xy_m":body(x)},
                         "other_body_vertices_xy_m":body(13)})
        frames=[{"video_frame":i,"carla_frame":r["frame"],"time_s":r["time_s"]} for i,r in enumerate(rows)]
        (root/"officer_history.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in rows))
        (root/"video_frames.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in frames))

    def test_original_frame_control_at_entry_without_legal_conclusion(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp);self.fixture(root)
            result=measure.analyze(root)
            self.assertTrue(result["officer_control_observed_at_entry"])
            self.assertEqual(result["first_ego_entry"]["frame"],102)
            self.assertTrue(result["other_inside_at_ego_entry"])
            self.assertEqual(result["subsection_2_applicability"],"officer_control_exception_candidate")
            self.assertEqual(result["legal_conclusion"],"unresolved")
            self.fixture(root,False)
            self.assertFalse(measure.analyze(root)["officer_control_observed_at_entry"])

    def test_stale_frame_and_missing_direction_source_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp);self.fixture(root)
            frames=[json.loads(r) for r in (root/"video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
            frames[1]["carla_frame"]=999
            (root/"video_frames.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in frames))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"frame join"):measure.analyze(root)
            self.fixture(root)
            rows=[json.loads(r) for r in (root/"officer_history.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
            rows[1]["direction_frame_source"]=""
            (root/"officer_history.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in rows))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"video frame source"):measure.analyze(root)

    def test_real_native_performer_spawn_and_cleanup(self):
        location=NS(x=5.0,y=0.0,z=0.0)
        transform=NS(location=location)
        destroyed=[]
        actor=NS(get_location=lambda:location,destroy=lambda:destroyed.append(True))
        world=NS(try_spawn_actor=lambda blueprint,where:actor)
        with construction.spawn_officer_performer(world,"source-reviewed-blueprint",transform,NS(x=10,y=0,z=0)) as built:
            self.assertEqual(built["surveyed_distance_to_junction_m"],5)
        self.assertEqual(destroyed,[True])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"placement"):
            with construction.spawn_officer_performer(world,"blueprint",NS(location=NS(x=10,y=0,z=0)),NS(x=10,y=0,z=0)):
                pass
